job.title: Regional Sales Manager - East & Central Europe
job.description:
Serving the composite manufacturing industry through the distribution of advanced composites, specialty polymers, and essential consumables, this established organisation combines the resources and stability of a global player with the agility of private ownership. You will deliver technical solutions to clients across wind energy, marine, automotive, aerospace, and transportation sectors, backed by a company with the investment capability and commitment to support your success.

The Opportunity
  • Own and grow sales across your designated regional territory
  • Prospect new business opportunities and develop qualified leads
  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to contract close
  • Build strong relationships with engineers, procurement teams, and key decision-makers
  • Provide technical guidance and application support to customers
 
What You Bring
  • 3-5 years of sales experience, ideally within composites or advanced materials
  • Ideally a working knowledge of composite materials and core materials applications
  • Proven ability to work independently and drive results with minimal supervision
  • Self-motivated with strong prospecting and business development skills
  • Technical aptitude with ability to understand customer applications
  • Willingness to travel extensively within your region

If you are a hungry, self-directed sales professional with composites knowledge looking to make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Project Engineer - Composites
job.description:
This is a hands-on, end to end engineering role covering the full component manufacturing lifecycle, from initial concept and prototyping, production, testing and final assembly. Taking lead on process development and project delivery, you will be working across high value industries such as defence, aerospace and marine and at every stage collaborating with customers, suppliers and internal teams.
 
Responsibilities Include:
  • Drive engineering solutions across the entire project lifecycle. 
  • Assess technical risk defining development plans and report against project delivery
  • 3D solid modelling and CAD documentation
  • Design of tooling
  • Design for manufacturing
  • Plan and supervise process qualification
  • Production troubleshooting and problem resolution
  • Identify and develop emerging composites technologies
  • Shape engineering solutions aligned to commercial strategy
  • Contribute to technology road map for targeted opportunities
  
What are we looking for?
  • Expert user of CAD software (SolidWorks). Able to design components for prototyping and final design
  • A technically strong and commercially aware engineer with knowledge of composite manufacturing processes
  • You will be confident leading, communicating and collaborating across disciplines, equally at ease with clients as you are with internal teams.
  • An engineer who can navigate complex engineering challenges, balancing competing technical and commercial demands to find the right solution
  • Importantly, you will be a team player, actively contributing to the wider team's capability and growth.
